The '''Shepherd''' is a [[villager]] profession that sells wool by the stack, lambs and shepherding tools. Its job site block is the Loom. Unlike the vanilla shepherd, it buys no wool.

All trades can be used 999 times before restocking.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/shepherd/1/white_wool.json}}</ref>

* At Novice level the shepherd offers all 16 colors of wool, 64 blocks for 1 obol each.
* At Apprentice level it offers 2 of the 4 trades: the [[Shepherd's Shears]] (with Looting III, for 3 obols) or a lamb. Each lamb is only offered in a biome of the matching climate: the [[Livestock#Lambs|White Lamb]] in temperate biomes, the Black Lamb in cold biomes and the Brown Lamb in warm biomes.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/shepherd/2/baby_cold_sheep.json}}</ref>
* At Journeyman level it sells the [[Crook]].
* The shepherd has no Expert or Master trades.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/shepherd/4/filler.json}}</ref>

Like every villager, a shepherd that has been traded with also buys its [[favorite food]] once.
